meaning:
παρ-αγγελία, -ας, ἡ
(παραγγέλλω),
an instruction, charge, com­mand: Act.5:28 16:24, 1Th.4:2, 1Ti.1:5 1:18. (In Xen., Polyb., of a military order.)†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood…
For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith,
